clue.text: Thinks about prisoners being given a time in place of worship inside

indicators.note: the prisoners are handed something to hold, so everything else sits between their letters

parts.note: cons are convicts

indicators.note: inside tells us the short time phrase goes within the place of worship

parts.note: a temple is a building for worship
taken as written
T is the usual abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Someone reflects on inmates being allowed time for worship inside a prison chapel.
explanation.walkthrough: Two containers nest here: the short time phrase sits within the place of worship, which in turn sits within the prisoners.
explanation.definitionFit: To contemplate is to ponder or consider something at length, a synonym for thinks about.

clue.text: Tree with fruit he plucked one by one

indicators.note: plucked one by one means the two letters of he are picked out separately, from different places

parts.note: cherries are fruit
taken as written

explanation.surface: A tree bearing fruit that a man picked individually.
explanation.walkthrough: The H and E come out of CHERRIES singly: the H second and the later E. The cerris is the Turkey oak.
explanation.definitionFit: Cerris is the Turkey oak, Quercus cerris, a large European tree with mossy acorn cups.

clue.text: Having a network working in Denver

indicators.note: working letters are being moved about and put to use in a new order

parts.note: the American city, taken as letters

explanation.surface: Someone has a professional network up and running in Denver.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Network' reads as business contacts; botanically, a nerved leaf has a network of veins (nerves).
explanation.definitionFit: In botany and entomology, nerved means furnished with nerves or veins, which form a branching network in a leaf or wing.

clue.text: Learner has come down, needing a little support externally

indicators.note: externally means the support sits on the outside, wrapped round the other part

parts.note: a golf tee is a small peg supporting the ball
rain is what comes down from the sky

explanation.surface: A beginner has fallen and needs a bit of support from outside.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'little support' is the peg a golf ball rests on, not a crutch.
explanation.definitionFit: A trainee is someone still being taught a job, exactly a learner.

clue.text: Maiden meets Jacob's son, a flirt

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
Asher was one of the twelve sons of Jacob in Genesis

explanation.surface: A young woman encounters a son of Jacob who turns out to be a flirt.
explanation.definitionFit: A masher is an old slang term for a man who makes advances to women, a lady-killer or flirt.

clue.text: Old-fashioned demonstration set off fire in gym

indicators.note: in says the reworked letters sit inside the gym abbreviation
setting something off disturbs it, so its letters are shaken into a different order

parts.note: first half of PE, physical education, the gym lesson
the letters of fire rearranged
second half of PE

explanation.surface: A demonstration in the school gym set off a fire.
explanation.walkthrough: PE (physical education) is the school gym lesson; the rearranged FIRE goes between its two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Preife is an obsolete Spenserian spelling of proof, and a proof is a demonstration that something is true.

clue.text: Group of plants, many regularly found in meadow

indicators.note: found in means the picked letters are placed inside the meadow

parts.note: a lea is a meadow, a poetic word for grassland

indicators.note: regularly means taking letters at even intervals, every other one, from many

parts.note: the word whose alternate letters are taken

explanation.surface: Plants grow in large numbers here and there across a field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the first and third letters of many, M and N, which are 'found in' LEA between its E and A.
explanation.definitionFit: Lemna is the botanical genus of the duckweeds, a group of tiny floating water plants.

clue.text: PM ignoring the Queen? That could be hairy!

indicators.note: ignoring something leaves it out, so the royal abbreviation is dropped

parts.note: Margaret Thatcher, British Prime Minister 1979 to 1990
ER, Elizabeth Regina, the Queen's cipher

explanation.surface: A Prime Minister snubbing the monarch: that could get dicey!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hairy' reads as dangerous, but here it means made of hair: a thatch is a thick head of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A thatch is informally a thick mop of hair on someone's head, so it is something hairy.

clue.text: Sun in this place no longer bright?

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for sun (and Sunday)
here means in this place

explanation.surface: The sun here has lost its brightness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No longer' marks an obsolete word rather than a fading light.
explanation.definitionFit: Shere is an obsolete form of sheer, which once meant bright, clear or shining.

clue.text: Beginning to escape, Spice Girl may get a female adviser

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its opening letter only

parts.note: first letter of escape
Geri Halliwell, Ginger Spice of the Spice Girls
taken as written

explanation.surface: A Spice Girl starting to break away might find herself a woman to advise her.
explanation.definitionFit: Egeria, the nymph who counselled King Numa of Rome, gives her name to any woman who acts as a mentor or adviser.

clue.text: Some dry goods in untidy heap at front of hospital

indicators.note: an untidy pile has its parts out of order, so these letters are rearranged
at front of places the rearranged pile before the hospital letter

parts.note: the letters of heap rearranged
H is the map and road-sign abbreviation for hospital

explanation.surface: Groceries lie in a messy pile at the entrance to the hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a quantity: some dry goods means an amount measured out.
explanation.definitionFit: An ephah is an ancient Hebrew unit of dry measure, used for grain, so it is a quantity of dry goods.

clue.text: Spider very dry secures a drain finally, ending in latrine

indicators.note: to secure something is to hold it fast, so the outer word holds the rest within it

parts.note: arid means extremely dry
taken as written

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the drain

parts.note: last letter of drain

indicators.note: the ending of a word is its last letter

parts.note: last letter of latrine

explanation.surface: A spider in a parched outhouse makes its home in the drain near the latrine.
explanation.walkthrough: The single A and the two end letters all go inside the word for very dry.
explanation.definitionFit: Araneid is the zoological term for any spider of the order Araneae, a true spider.

clue.text: Country folk right by mountain range

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for right
the Urals, the range dividing Europe from Asia

explanation.surface: Rustic people living just beside a range of mountains.
explanation.definitionFit: Rurals is a noun for people who live in rural areas, the inhabitants of the countryside.

clue.text: Historic decay in extended realm? Source of anguish for one

indicators.note: for means one letter is put in place of another, standing for it

parts.note: an empire is an extended realm, many lands under one ruler
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: source of means the first letter of anguish, where it begins

parts.note: the word whose first letter is taken

explanation.surface: An empire in decline causes distress to an individual.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Source of' anguish gives A, which goes 'for' the I (one) of EMPIRE. Empare is an old Spenserian spelling of impair, so here a noun, decay.
explanation.definitionFit: Empare is an obsolete form of impair, recorded as meaning deterioration or damage, so historic decay.

clue.text: Fab musician with sitar to chant outside hotel

parts.note: Ravi Shankar, the famous Indian sitar player

indicators.note: outside means the chanting word wraps round the hotel letter

parts.note: to sing is to chant
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A Beatle-era sitar player singing outside a hotel: very Fab Four.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fab' recalls the Beatles, who studied with Ravi Shankar, but it is simply the definition, fabulous.
explanation.definitionFit: Fab is slang for fabulous, and ravishing likewise means delightful or strikingly beautiful.

clue.text: Film providing some lurid entertainment

indicators.note: some of the following words supplies the letters, a run taken from inside them

parts.note: found across lurID ENTertainment

explanation.surface: A movie offering a bit of sensational fun.
explanation.definitionFit: An ident is a short piece of film a TV channel shows to identify itself between programmes.

clue.text: A slider in trouble comes off the track

indicators.note: something in trouble is in disarray, so its letters are jumbled

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A sliding object gets into difficulty and leaves the rails.
explanation.definitionFit: A train that derails leaves its rails, which is literally coming off the track.

clue.text: Spots what sounds like an East End carriage?

indicators.note: sounds like says we go by how the phrase is spoken, not spelt

parts.note: a Hackney carriage with the dropped H of Cockney speech

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about a cab from London's East End.
explanation.walkthrough: A Hackney carriage is a London taxi; Cockneys in the East End drop the H.
explanation.definitionFit: Acne is a skin condition producing pimples, which are commonly called spots in Britain.

clue.text: Educator retaining only one element of basic education — not a loyal type

indicators.note: retaining means holding on to, so the educator word keeps the other letter inside it

parts.note: a teacher educates

parts.words: only one element of basic education
parts.note: one of the three Rs: reading, writing and arithmetic

explanation.surface: A teacher who keeps to only one of the basics proves unfaithful.
explanation.walkthrough: R goes after the T of TEACHER.
explanation.definitionFit: Treacher is an old word for a traitor, someone disloyal.

clue.text: Foot's getting cold after job, restricting one

indicators.note: restricting means the job and cold hold one in, confining it
after means the cold letter follows the job

parts.note: a chore is a job, a routine task
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone's foot goes chilly after a task that keeps a person confined.
explanation.walkthrough: 'restricting' puts I between CHORE and C. Foot's is the definition: choreic means relating to a choree, the metrical foot also called a trochee.
explanation.definitionFit: Choreic describes something of a choree, the metrical foot of a long syllable then a short one.

clue.text: So this could be a forest? Erm, possibly!

definitions.text: So this could be a forest? Erm, possibly!

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters could be shuffled into something else

parts.note: part of the composite anagram fodder, used as written
part of the composite anagram fodder, used as written
the letters added to the answer to make up the fodder

explanation.surface: A hesitant speaker wonders whether a wood counts as a forest.
explanation.walkthrough: A composite anagram: SO plus the answer ('this') are an anagram of A FOREST ERM. Take the letters of so out of a forest and erm and rearrange the rest; read whole, the clue describes a plantation of trees.
explanation.definitionFit: A tree farm is a plantation of trees grown as a crop, which could well look like a forest.

clue.text: Remove old lines somehow with introduction of Olay

indicators.note: somehow says the letters arrive in some undetermined order, so they are shuffled

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: an introduction comes first, so just the opening letter of the brand is used

parts.note: first letter of Olay, the skincare brand

explanation.surface: An advert: get rid of old wrinkles with a dab of Olay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old' looks like it should give O, but it marks the definition as archaic; the O comes from Olay.
explanation.definitionFit: Esloin is an obsolete word meaning to remove or withdraw, hence the old in the definition.

clue.text: Aged man's being buried — to get resurrected, as the Bard would have it?

definitions.text: to get resurrected, as the Bard would have it

indicators.note: something buried is placed inside, so the man's name goes within the age abbreviation

parts.note: ae. is short for Latin aetatis, aged, as on gravestones
Ray's, the man's name with its S

explanation.surface: An old man's burial, with the hope of rising again, in Shakespearean style.
explanation.walkthrough: RAYS goes inside AE, the abbreviation seen on tombstones for 'aged'. The Bard is Shakespeare, who uses this form in All's Well That Ends Well.
explanation.definitionFit: Arayse is Shakespeare's spelling of araise, to raise, here to raise from the dead.

clue.text: Minister, a politician providing overhaul

parts.note: Rev, short for Reverend, a minister of religion
taken as written
Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A minister and a politician come up with a reform package.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Minister' suggests a government post, but here it is a clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: A revamp is a renovation or makeover, a synonym for an overhaul.

clue.text: English knight king (a new king) put in position as before

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for English
N is the knight in chess notation
R, Rex, king
taken as written
N is the abbreviation for new
K is king in chess and cards

explanation.walkthrough: 'As before' marks an archaic word.
explanation.definitionFit: Enrank is an old verb meaning to place in rank or order, to set in position.

clue.text: Shrink from someone trying to be funny — that woman!

parts.note: a wit is a person who makes clever jokes

explanation.definitionFit: To wither is to shrivel or dry up, a synonym for shrink.

clue.text: Party hit with embarrassment having ditched leader

parts.note: to abash is to make someone embarrassed

explanation.walkthrough: 'Party' looks political, but it is the celebration sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A bash is informal for a lively party or celebration.

clue.text: Father maybe to ask for money with extremes of embarrassment

clue.text: Jack, heading off, one to rise up hill

clue.text: Below a Welsh location

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Eel is cooked in vinegar no longer

clue.text: The writer at home that is establishing old-style household

i.e., id est, that is

clue.text: Having secured corner that's quiet, maybe watch bird

indicators.note: having secured means the watch holds the next letters fast inside it

parts.note: ticker is slang for a watch
